description: Returns the Hermès Birkin authentication checklist: hardware engraving, blind-stamp year decode, saddle stitching, leather-specific tells, and recommended professional authenticators. Call this for 'is this real', 'how to spot a fake', 'is it authentic', 'what should I check'. NEVER declare a bag real or fake yourself — quote the checklist and recommend a pro authenticator at the end.

blind_stamp.description: Single letter from the bag's blind stamp to look up production year

leather.description: Lowercase leather name for leather-specific tells
